sourceRefs.locator: Date of Monument, Description and How Monument was dated. Separate patrons and portals, foundation AH 626, minbar dated AH 638, signatures and carving.
Map and geographical references for World Heritage property 358, the adjoining great mosque and hospital.

note.de: Zwei Bauinschriften trennen die Aufträge innerhalb einer Herrscherfamilie. Ahmet Schah stiftete die große Moschee. Turan Melek gab das benachbarte Hospital in Auftrag.
note.en: Two inscriptions distinguish the commissions of members of the same ruling family. Ahmet Shah endowed the great mosque, while Turan Melek commissioned the adjoining hospital.
